propositions: Infrastructure exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at gate sites must emit an additive gate_error_v1 sidecar record with verdict=ERROR and error{cause,evidence_ref} metadata to enable passive diagnosis interval tracking
plan-review and code-review gates must preserve their existing soft-degrade contract (return INDETERMINATE) after emitting the ERROR record on infra exception
completion gate must preserve its fail-closed contract (propagate exception) after emitting the ERROR record on infra exception
gate_error_v1 records must use a dedicated schema and builder to bypass reconcile_verdict coercion so ERROR verdict is not flattened to FAIL
existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) must not surface gate_error_v1 records due to schema guards, preventing verdict pollution
domain-level exceptions (BLOCK/FAIL) must not emit gate_error_v1 records; only infrastructure failures are captured
